Name: Agricultural Diary
Author: Mackuns
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#C38B55]🌱 AGRICULTURAL DIARY[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][i][color=#E1BA78]Plan, grow, and harvest at your own pace.[/color][/i][/size][/center]

[size=3]Inspired by the nostalgia of checking Stardew Valley Wiki's crop calendars, [b]Agricultural Diary[/b] brings that familiar idea into the game as an interactive journal with more tools to plan your farm.

Explore crop growth stages, estimate harvest dates, and organize your planting schedule across all four seasons.[/size]


[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]📖 MAIN FEATURES[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]
[b]Dynamic Calendar:[/b] Visualize crop growth from planting to harvest.

[b]Four Seasons:[/b] Explore spring, summer, fall, and winter crops.

[b]Growth Calculations:[/b] Compare Speed-Gro fertilizers and the Agriculturist profession bonus.

[b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] Supports additional crops and their custom textures when compatible with the game's data.

[b]Progressive Journal:[/b] Purchase seasonal chapters at Pierre's shop and watch your diary change as you unlock them.[/size]



[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]💰 HOW TO GET IT[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]Agricultural Diary is available at Pierre's shop. Start with a seasonal chapter, unlock more as you progress, or purchase the complete diary.[/size]

[spoiler]
[size=3][b][color=#E1BA78]CHAPTER PRICES[/color][/b]

First seasonal chapter + diary: [b]500g[/b]

Additional seasonal chapter: [b]1,500g[/b]

Complete diary (all four seasons): [b]8,000g[/b][/size][/spoiler]


[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]🛠️ INSTALLATION[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Agricultural Diary and extract the [b]DiarioAgricola[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
4. Visit Pierre's shop to purchase your first chapter.[/size]



[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]🌿 COMPATIBILITY[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]
[b]Tested with:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2.

Supports [color=#fff2cc]modded[/color] crops and texture replacements when they use compatible game data. [b]Content Patcher is not required.[/b]

Chapter progress is tracked per player. Full multiplayer compatibility, including split-screen, has not yet been fully verified.[/size]
[spoiler][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55094/55094-1793928103-1331328853.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55094/55094-1793928101-2063805806.png[/img][/size][/spoiler]




[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]🌎 AVAILABLE LANGUAGES[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=3]English · Español · Português (Brasil) · 简体中文 · Русский[/size][/center]


[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]The diary provides growth estimates and does not modify actual crops.

Calculations assume proper watering and do not automatically include special environmental bonuses, such as faster paddy crop growth near water.

Mods that change farming mechanics may produce results different from the diary's estimates.[/size]


[center][size=4][b][color=#C38B55]💬 FEEDBACK & BUG REPORTS[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]Found a bug or have a suggestion? Feel free to share your feedback on this mod page.

For bug reports, please include steps to reproduce the issue and, if possible, your SMAPI log.[/size]
